# 招聘信息

## 硕士毕业论文项目

我们为机器人与智能系统理学硕士（MSc in Robotics and Intelligent Systems）学生提供多个课题。详情请参阅本科生/硕士生页面。

## 招聘职位

团队欢迎优秀的博士后、研究生与本科生加入。博士后岗位视每年四月与十月左右的资助结果而定。若您的背景与课题组方向匹配，我们会回复。

### 申请博士后（Postdoctoral Associate）

  * 机器人与人工智能： 具备计算机视觉（实时图像处理）与机器人控制的扎实经验，以及较强的软件开发能力。
  * 研资局青年研究学者计划（RGC Junior Research Fellow Scheme）： 我们也支持申请人申请该计划。该计划旨在鼓励博士毕业生投身研究事业，并在其职业生涯早期的关键阶段提供支持。

### 申请博士研究生（方向：1. 计算机视觉与机器人；2. 机电一体化）

  * 机器人： 具备计算机视觉（实时图像处理）、机器人控制与软件开发的扎实经验。
  * 智能传感器与执行器： 具备器件设计与微纳加工经验，以及电路搭建与嵌入式控制系统经验。
  * 入学时间： 灵活
  * 硕士学位： 非必须；亦欢迎 GPA 优异、科研记录突出的本科毕业生申请直博。
  * 研资局 JRFS 奖学金： 强烈鼓励博士申请人申请 RGC JRFS，该奖学金可提供更高资助。RGC JRFS 2025/26 申请期为 2024 年 9 月 1 日至 2024 年 12 月 1 日。（请以研资局最新通告为准。）

有意者请将简历与成绩单电邮至刘军教授（djliu@hku.hk）。可选材料包括研究陈述，以及由推荐人直接寄送的推荐信。--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Scholarships and Funding

Strong applicants are nominated for the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS) and the HKU Presidential PhD Scholar Programme (HKU-PS). At HKU, HKPFS awardees also receive HKU-PS and matching university support, so the two packages come out broadly equivalent — roughly HK$1.7 million (about USD 219,300) over four years, comprising:

  * a monthly PhD stipend
  * tuition waiver for the normal period of study
  * research and living cash awards
  * an annual conference and research travel allowance
  * guaranteed on-campus accommodation in the first year

获得国家奖学金、一等奖学金、专业排名靠前或具有突出科研经历的申请人，将获重点支持申请HKPFS及HKU-PS。没有发表论文也可以申请。

  * Health Technology and Healthcare

  * New Materials

Financial Aspects

The maximum funding per project for this call is HK$800,000. If the total funding for the selected projects does not exhaust the allocated budget, a subsequent call for proposals may be launched at a later date to select additional projects.

Funding awarded will only be used on the HKUST CWB campus and will not be subcontracted or transferred outside the CWB campus. If industry partners or collaborators are involved in a proposed project, funding cannot be used to advance the commercial interests of such partners/collaborators. In addition, funding cannot be used to match any PGS or internal funding, such as the Equipment Competition Fund.

The proposal should only include research equipment specific to the proposed project. General equipment and accessories will not be funded.

Funding will be allocated in stages based on participation and communication with joint labs and/or institutes, as well as a review of annual progress reports indicating the milestones achieved. All PIs must comply with the management agreement between HKUST and the respective donor regarding the project and submit progress and/or final reports.
